annotations.title: Find the coin that pays a network’s fees

description: Explains which coin pays network fees ("gas") on a chain and how to get a little of it, for someone whose tokens are stuck because the wallet holds none of that coin (for example USDT on Tron with no TRX). Chains: tron, bsc, solana, ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, avalanche.

chain.description: The chain the stuck tokens are on

name: gas_help
